problems.what: the hook is a flat pink field: before the far flats land, everything below the sky bands is horizon pink (about 60 % of the landscape frame, 70 % of the vertical), so the first second and a half reads as an abstract colour block, not a forest
problems.fix: a dark stage floor below a thin pink horizon strip, and flats that are never seen with a cut bottom edge

problems.what: the fern flat lowers in from above with its mounded bed: its flat-bottomed humps cross the whole frame as floating black slabs (in the vertical a near-black slab with square notches covers ~40 % of the frame for six frames); the clearing and ridge flats show the same hard bottom edge as they wipe down
problems.fix: ground-anchored flats (ridge, far pines, clearing, mid pines, ferns) rise from under the stage like toy-theatre ground rows, so only their top silhouettes ever enter; only the near trunks, which run off both edges, still lower from above

problems.what: fourteen seconds of one glide: 0 changes per 10 s, longest calm 24 s; between the title leaving and the lamp the only events are gradual rack pulls, so the middle of the film has no punch at all
problems.fix: events on the beat grid that stay inside the multiplane look: an owl sweeping close past the camera, a gust that sways the pines and trunks, a deer on the clearing that bolts as the pines part while every firefly flashes at once, and a warm flare when the lamp lights

problems.what: the lower third is a large empty field of ground with only the pale path in it
problems.fix: stepping stones up the path, a split-rail fence either side and a woodpile, on the clearing flat so they parallax with it

problems.what: the cabin's dark door is the same near-black as the unlit window, so at phone size the cabin has two windows
problems.fix: a lighter door with a step under it

problems.what: rack focus steps between blur levels: a flat visibly pops from sharp to half-resolution in one frame
the far pines read as a row of hanging triangles against the thin pink strip
problems.fix: raise the vertical's ridge so less pink shows between the pine tips

rounds.paceNote: changesPer10s counts mean frame differences above 18 grey levels, which only the lamp's flare reaches: a one-shot camera glide with actors inside it under-reads. On the sheets something new arrives every 2-3 s (flats 0-3.6 s, the walk 3.6 s, the owl's close pass 6 s, the gust 9 s, the deer 10.2-13.2 s, the firefly flash 13.2 s, the owl landing 16.2 s, the lamp and flare 18 s, the last line 21.6 s), with two punches (the owl pass, the flare). No fake cut was added to game the metric
